objective.text: Attach domain identifiers through an exception's context method without placing secrets in its message.

difficulty.rationale: Supply searchable domain metadata without hiding it in prose or exposing unrelated secrets.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A custom import exception should add import_id=42 to its reported log context. Which class method is intended to supply that structured data?

options.text: __toString() appending a JSON object to the exception text
